release_requirements.python: exact .python-version + backend/uv.lock when backend is real
release_requirements.node: exact toolchain version + frontend/package-lock.json when frontend is real
release_requirements.containers: all release/production images must match release-images-lock.json and use immutable @sha256 digest
release_requirements.agent_skills: exact audited commit in external-skills-lock.json + installed tree hash
release_requirements.release_image_lock: release-images-lock.json is the canonical immutable image set for CI release gates

development_exception: docker-compose.target.yml is local-development only and is governed by development-images-lock.json. Mutable development tags never satisfy production/release gates.
development_images: development-images-lock.json; review <= 90 days; never production evidence
